_comment: Hand-written. Where each interactive figure goes: 'label' is a LaTeX \label of a figure or of a (sub)section in the notes; the interactive is placed right after that figure or heading. 'at': 'end' (optional, D57; a section or subsection label only) places it at the end of that (sub)section's content instead. 'module' is the file notes/diffgeo-gr/assets/interactive/<module>.js. Regenerating the pages never touches this file or the modules. 'steps' (optional, D58) lists named boxes of a TikZ figure, in order, for a panel that steps through them. 'notebook' (optional) is the path of the notebook in the package repository (github.com/daniellopezcano/differential_geometry, branch main) that the panel's footer links to (D55).

interactives.label: fig_EH_chain_rule
interactives._comment: D58. 'steps' are the figure's top-level local bounding boxes (figures/fig-eh-chain-rule.boxes.json), in the reading order its caption states: 'Step 3 of Subsection ..., read along a U. Left column, going down (grey): the product rule splits the derivative of the integrand into those of the volume element (A) and of the Ricci scalar (B); (B) splits into those of the inverse metric (C) and of the Ricci curvature (D); (D) requires that of the connection coefficients (E), at the bottom, which uses (C). Right column, going up (blue): the results are inserted back, each next to the panel it completes: (E) into (D) gives (F), (C) and (F) into (B) give (G), and (A) and (G) into the first line give (H).' The first line (Sbox), then A to E, the (*) of (E) (Xbox) right after E, then F, G, H.
